shared_qualifications: C2: Source methods (PDF p.2) used Ag/AgCl (3 M KCl), E=0.208 V vs SHE, and explicitly report all results on SHE. Convert the already reported SHE numbers, without applying 0.208 V again: E_mV(SCE)=E_mV(SHE)-241, conditional on a 25 C saturated-KCl SCE convention. Corrtest CS900 manufacturer specifies +0.241 V vs NHE at 25 C (https://www.corrtestinstruments.com/en/02437.html). Reference-electrode temperature is not established by the consulted paper methods; CRA 25 C alone is not paper evidence. Under this stated convention 1172-241=931 and 1164-241=923 mV. Agreement is conditional, not proof of the original curators' calibration.

Table 3 labels the chloride-free acid endpoints Epit, but PDF p.3 discusses transpassive dissolution and oxygen evolution in H2SO4; p.6 reports little/no pitting for the Al-free alloy. Identity is retained with this physical qualification.
